label: S. 629
title: Emergency Conservation Program Improvement Act of 2025

items.snippet: This act revises the Emergency Conservation Program (ECP) and the Emergency Forest Restoration Program (EFRP) to expand eligibility for payments to agricultural producers and owners of forest land impacted by natural disasters.
